name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 1V — WSON
description: Surface-mount 1V LDO linear regulator ICs housed in 6-pin WSON packages with an exposed thermal pad.
selection_hints: Require a 1V SMD LDO linear regulator in a WSON package.
Select the footprint variant according to thermal via layout requirements.
Choose between Tier A parts such as LP5912-1.0DRV, TLV75510PDRV, or TLV75710PDRV.
avoid_when: Output voltages other than 1V are required.
Packages other than WSON-6 are needed.
Non-LDO or non-linear regulator IC topologies are required.
